original_service: PyPI advisory service via pip-audit; reviewed GitHub advisories and CNA/ZDI verified separately

findings.vulnerable_range: PyPA: introduced 0, last_affected 5.0.0rc0. CNA names affected commit d1c6310d6a02481d48d81607cba7840be04580d1 and otherwise unknown status; no complete CNA SemVer range.
findings.functionality: X-CLIP checkpoint conversion and unsafe deserialization
findings.reachable: Not through this project: no checkpoint converter or untrusted checkpoint loading. Converter file is absent from both inspected installed wheels.
findings.disposition: No declared upstream fixed version; residual vendor-status uncertainty. Selected version is outside the PyPA listed range; scanner disappearance is not proof of a vendor fix.
findings.mitigation: Use only the fixed-revision reviewed cached MiniLM encoder. Do not add or execute X-CLIP conversion/checkpoint scripts. Retain this caveat and recheck vendor advisories.
findings.dependency: Direct requirement and transitive requirement of sentence-transformers; its encoder backend is used, so removal is not compatible.

findings.reachable: Not through this project: no Trainer/resume-training path; advisory additionally describes torch below 2.6, while installed torch is 2.14.1.
findings.disposition: Resolved by release upgrade to 5.17.0. Old duplicate audit records disagree on 5.0.0 vs 5.0.0rc3; GitHub reviewed affected/patched table used.
findings.mitigation: Keep the upgraded release lock; do not resume untrusted checkpoints.
findings.dependency: Direct requirement and transitive requirement of sentence-transformers; its encoder backend is used, so removal is not compatible.

findings.functionality: Malicious attention implementation in a model configuration loads remote kernel code
findings.reachable: The encoder does load model config, but callers cannot supply config/model IDs. It uses one immutable MiniLM revision, local cache only and no remote code. No attacker-config path was found; this is source-review inference, not exploit testing.
findings.mitigation: Keep the upgraded lock and fixed-revision offline encoder. trust_remote_code=False alone was not a sufficient mitigation for the old flaw.
findings.dependency: Direct requirement and transitive requirement of sentence-transformers; its encoder backend is used, so removal is not compatible.

findings.functionality: LightGlue nested model configuration bypasses remote-code trust policy
findings.reachable: Not through this project: MiniLM BERT encoder only; no LightGlue or caller-provided nested model config.
findings.disposition: Resolved by release upgrade to 5.17.0; reviewed advisory supplies the missing fix from one old audit record.
findings.mitigation: Keep the upgraded lock and restrict models/configs to the reviewed encoder.
findings.dependency: Direct requirement and transitive requirement of sentence-transformers; its encoder backend is used, so removal is not compatible.

findings.reachable: Not through this project: no tokenizer/processor save_pretrained or untrusted chat-template output path.
findings.mitigation: Keep upgraded lock; do not introduce untrusted model/tokenizer export paths.
findings.dependency: Direct requirement and transitive requirement of sentence-transformers; its encoder backend is used, so removal is not compatible.

findings.vulnerable_range: Published advisory: >=4.49.0, <=5.8.1; source inspection also finds download-before-consent in the 5.10.0 through 5.16.0 minor release tags. Treat the published upper bound cautiously.
findings.functionality: load_custom_generate() downloads Python before asking permission; execution is separately gated
findings.reachable: Not through this project: no custom generation or generative model; the MiniLM worker is offline.
findings.disposition: Advisory still lists no patched version. Upstream correcting commit cbc1651 and the selected 5.17.0 tag/installed wheel show trust validation before get_cached_module_file. This is verified code mitigation, not an invented advisory fixed-version declaration.
findings.mitigation: Selected 5.17.0 rather than 5.10.0 based on source verification. Continue avoiding custom generation; retain advisory-data uncertainty.
findings.dependency: Direct requirement and transitive requirement of sentence-transformers; its encoder backend is used, so removal is not compatible.
